name: Langhorne Creek

climate: Shiraz and Cabernet Sauvignon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

blurb.text: A region in South Australia's Fleurieu area, on the plains along the lower Bremer and Angas Rivers, reaching Lake Alexandrina.
